fields.name: number
fields.description: Number sequence to analyze (1-8 digits). Can be any number the user has encountered: clock times (1111), addresses (717), receipts (888), license plates (4444), or any repeating pattern.

fields.name: context
fields.description: Where the number was seen. When supplied, the response adds a contextNote tailoring the reading to the sighting: clock (a glanced time), receipt (a purchase), license-plate (in transit), phone (a call or notification), address (a home or place), price (a total or amount).
